profile.name: Jens Wölm
profile.title: B. Eng. Architecture
profile.bio: My architectural approach combines natural materials, especially wood, with clear geometric forms and sustainable construction. I focus on the interplay of light, texture, and function – from the initial sketch in model making to the detailed execution planning.

projects.title: Renovation of the Thannhausen Local History Museum
projects.shortDescription: Renovation and conversion of a small barn into a museum and event space for the village Thannhausen in southern Germany.

projects.title: New Housing - Starkenburg Barracks
projects.shortDescription: Redevelopment of the Starkenburg Barracks in Darmstadt, an innovative neighborhood design is to be developed that creates high-quality and sustainable housing. This should meet the needs of future residents and foster appropriate interaction with the surrounding area.
